title: Red Velvet Brownies with Cream Cheese Frosting
changes_from_base: White chocolate and natural cocoa batter coloured red, with a cream cheese frosting; no dark chocolate.
summary: White chocolate and cocoa brownies coloured red, topped with tangy cream cheese frosting.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with baking paper
heatproof bowl and small pan (or a microwave)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line the tin.

steps.title: Melt
steps.text: Warm the butter and white chocolate together in short bursts, stirring, until just melted.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Whisk in both sugars, then the eggs, vanilla and colouring until smooth. Fold in the flour, cocoa and salt, then fold in the vinegar last. Spread in the tin.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 25-30 min, until the edges are set, the middle no longer looks wet and a cocktail stick comes out with a few crumbs. Cool completely, about 2 h.

steps.title: Frosting
steps.text: Beat the cream cheese and butter until smooth, then beat in the icing sugar and vanilla until fluffy.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Spread the frosting over the cold slab, chill 30 min so it firms, then cut into 16 with a clean, warm knife.

tips: Use natural cocoa, not Dutch-process, for the classic red tone.
Gel colouring gives strong colour without thinning the batter.
Frost only when the brownies are completely cold.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 4 days; let them stand 15 min before serving.
